limits: Exploratory whole-corpus counts; no held-out evaluation or generalization claim.
Known ports here means named saved-edge handles, not declared-port membership, activation or type compatibility.
Neighborhoods with any unknown incident port/type/endpoint, self-loop, or more than 24 features are excluded; selection bias is reported.
Connections are observed saved edges, not validated active outputs or behavior.
Two features share the same center occurrence; their outside neighbor may be shared (two-node pattern) or distinct (three-node pattern).
Source groups union repository identities and all origins of byte-identical files, including fixture origins. They do not prove independent sources or catch every modified copy.
Global lift is confounded by center type; the UI shows lift conditioned on the common center type.
No automatic composites, configuration inference, AnyBURL, PyClause or evolutionary execution in this study.
